description: This file defines the interface MaterialsProviderInterfaceV2 for AWS Crypto SDK in PHP, specifying methods related to cryptographic key management, encryption algorithms, and initialization vector generation.

classes.name: MaterialsProviderInterfaceV2
classes.description: An interface defining methods for cryptographic material providers, including key size support, wrapping algorithms, decryption of CEK, generation of CEK, and IV generation.

methods.name: isSupportedKeySize
methods.description: Checks if a particular key size (in bits) is supported for AES encryption.

methods.name: getWrapAlgorithmName
methods.description: Returns the name of the wrapping algorithm used by this provider.

methods.name: decryptCek
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted content encryption key (CEK) using provider-specific logic, given the encrypted key, material description, and options.

methods.name: generateCek
methods.description: Generates a new content encryption key (CEK) of a specified size, possibly using context and options.

methods.name: generateIv
methods.description: Generates an initialization vector (IV) using the specified OpenSSL cipher name.
